summary: Iteration 5 verified new Delete Lists / Restore / My To Do List features. 11/11 backend tests pass (added test_deleted_lists_roundtrip). All 10 frontend scenarios pass at 390x844: myTodo list position between engineService and shipsLog with todo-instructions, todo-skipper-tip, add-item-input placeholder 'Note a little issue to fix...'; todo-help-hide-btn <-> todo-help-show-btn with localStorage persistence across list switches AND reload; Ship's Log help independent; only one ListIntro in DOM at a time (no duplicate React key warnings in console); delete-list-btn in checklist-empty opens delete-list-dialog with cancel/confirm; deleting Head (Toilet) persists to cloud (GET /api/boats/<device_id> deleted_lists contains 'head'); custom Dinghy list can be deleted and is NOT restored by Reset All; Reset All restores deleted supplied lists at original position with original items (6 Head items) and clears cloud deleted_lists; validation guard shows top-validation-bar when creds missing and does NOT open the dialog; no horizontal overflow at 390px across leavingDock/myTodo/shipsLog/safety/mayDay/engineService.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.jsx reset() calls restoreDeletedLists(state) separately to compute names toast, then runs restoreDeletedLists(s).state inside mutate — correct and idempotent, but the names snapshot is read from stale closure state; acceptable because toast fires only right after click.

DEFAULT_DATA for shipsLog uses mk(87, ...) — contiguous id ranges across lists are maintained manually; adding a new supplied list requires updating subsequent id offsets. Fragile but not a bug today.
addMissingLists only auto-inserts head/engineService/myTodo for legacy state migration; a brand-new supplied list added later needs to be added to this allowlist too — document in defaults.js.
ListIntro useState initial reads localStorage once at mount; now safe because the key is prefixed in BoatPrep (intro-<id>) forcing a remount per list — correct.
seed_data_creation: ephemeral boats created with device_id auto-generated by frontend (localStorage mbp_device_id); vessel prefixed TEST_. Not cleaned up but prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: List selector is a native <select data-testid="list-selector">; use page.select_option(value='<id>') to switch lists (not click text). urllib default User-Agent is 403'd by the preview edge — use page.evaluate(fetch(...)) or requests library for backend reads. New data-testids added this iteration: todo-instructions, todo-skipper-tip, todo-help-hide-btn, todo-help-show-btn, log-help-hide-btn, log-help-show-btn, delete-list-btn (inside checklist-empty), delete-list-dialog, delete-list-cancel-btn, delete-list-confirm-btn. ListIntro keyed intro-<id> and AddItemForm keyed add-<id> — duplicate React key bug confirmed fixed (no console warnings during multi-list switch cycle myTodo->shipsLog->head->safety->mayDay).
